note: Each entry is a duplication that exists today. The list may only get shorter.

pairs.reason: the range-cell test, byte-identical. @modyra/widgets offers no daterange controller, so each renderer decides for itself which cells are the endpoints — and a third renderer answers it by comparing ISO strings instead of dates. Closes when the daterange controller lands (Batch 6) and the renderers consume it (Batch 7).

the clock dial's pointer tracking. widgets has createFocusCustodian, createLightDismiss and createTypeahead and no sibling for a drag, so three renderers each bind their own document listeners. Closes with createPointerDrag (Batch 6).
the other half of the same missing primitive: what the drag releases. A teardown written per renderer is how one of them comes to release one listener fewer.

the light-dismiss pointer origin. createLightDismiss exists and holds the policy; what is copied is the binding around it, and one of the three copies listens for one event fewer. Closes when the binding itself moves upstream (Batch 7).
